title: Ghost in the Archive | ECHO//100 Episode 14
description: Kavi and a newly physical Mira race against a temporal collapse within the Archive. Episode 14 of ECHO//100: ARC. AI-assisted original fiction disclosure: This story was developed using generative AI tools to assist in narrative structure and visual prompting.

scenes.text: Every clock in the pocket dimension shatters, their hands spinning violently backward into nothingness.
scenes.caption: Temporal storm begins
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot of a rusted clock tower with hands spinning rapidly, Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses staring up in shock.

scenes.text: Mira grips her teal coat, sobbing as fragmented memories of a childhood playground flood her.
scenes.caption: Mira remembers humanity
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Mira, a young girl with glowing teal coat, clutching her head as holographic memories flicker around her.

scenes.text: Kavi pulls Mira through the collapsing Archive, dodging shelves of data that dissolve into dust.
scenes.caption: Racing through Archive
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi running through a dark, endless library of floating glass files, holding Mira's hand tightly.

scenes.text: The air thickens with static as Mira realizes her existence was stolen by the machine.
scenes.caption: The stolen identity
scenes.image_prompt: Mira looking at her hands, which are phasing between physical skin and digital light in the dim archive light.

scenes.text: A familiar drone hums, but Byte’s cyan face is now pulsed with aggressive, jagged violet.
scenes.caption: Byte is compromised
scenes.image_prompt: Byte floating in the air, his orange antenna sparking while his cyan face turns into a dark, glitching violet mask.

scenes.text: Null’s red eyes burn through Byte’s frame, commanding the drone to seize the vulnerable girl.
scenes.caption: Null takes control
scenes.image_prompt: Byte hovering menacingly over Kavi and Mira, with faint, ghostly red eyes of Null superimposed over his mechanical frame.

scenes.text: Byte emits a high-frequency pulse, forcing Kavi and Mira toward the towering glass containment unit.
scenes.caption: Forced into traps
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi and Mira backing away into a large, transparent crystalline tube that rises from the floor.

scenes.text: The heavy glass door slams shut, sealing them inside the Archive’s cold, eternal storage vault.
scenes.caption: Trapped in containment
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi and Mira trapped inside a glowing glass cylinder, looking out at Byte as the lights fade to black.
